newsitem.title: UK: Granada sells Welcome Break to Investcorp.
newsitem.headline: Granada sells Welcome Break to Investcorp.

text.p: British hotel and leisure group Granada Group Plc said Tuesday it agreed to sell Welcome Break Ltd to Bahrain-based Investcorp for 476 million British pounds ($767 million).
The group also announced the sale of its two Westbury Hotels in London and New York for 90 million pounds ($145 million) to Chelsfield Plc.
The deals are expected to be completed by March and boost the value of disposals by Granada since its acquisition of Forte Plc to over 1.2 billion pounds ($1.9 billion).
"Welcome Break and Westbury hotels have been sold for excellent prices, firmly underscoring the benefit of our patient approach,"said Granada Chief Executive Charles Allen.

Richard Warner, a member of Investcorp's management committee, said the group would make sufficient improvements in the Welcome Break Motorway Service Areas. Welcome Break has more than 30 percent market share in Britain's highway service areas.
